Finite greedy policy is not a skilled human, balance evaluation, natural unlock proof or real-time play-duration measurement. Victories are not required; terminal completion and absence of errors/loops are gates. UI/browser coverage is separate.

swordPairedAnalysis.method: Matched 4 seeds per no-oath / sword_frost / sword_edge at long challenge 0; first 2 oath runs reuse the main matrix. Opening minus closing HP includes immediate victory healing. netActionHpLoss sums positive per-action HP changes, so is a net-change proxy, not gross incoming damage; oathSelfDamage and weaponSelfDamage use actual source-specific proc events; combinedOathWeaponSelfDamage uses the corresponding actual selfDamage event, avoiding attributing divine weapon costs to an oath. Policy refuses a card whose public preview predicts player death, and is a generic greedy heuristic rather than a sword-specialist policy.
